summary: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to expand eligibility for teacher and school leader quality partnership grants, update definitions, and enhance accountability measures for educator preparation programs, including establishing residency programs and a study on elevating the education profession.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses entirely on enhancing teacher and school leader quality partnership grants, which directly impacts public schools by improving the quality of educators and leadership. It aims to recruit and retain profession-ready individuals, especially in high-need areas, and provides funding for professional development and residency programs. This represents a significant investment in public education infrastructure and personnel.
